//Oidc: Oidc:Authority = the IDP (same address in every component). Oidc:ClientId must equal ClientIds:Shell in src/IDP/appsettings.json; the secret (Development) is in appsettings.Development.json and must equal ClientSecrets:<this client ID> in the IDP's settings.
//ShellOrigin: The Shell's own address (https): only its pages may open the notifications connection. Must equal ClientBaseUrls:Shell in src/IDP/appsettings.json and ShellOrigin in every MFE BFF.
//MfeOrigins: The MFEs the Shell may frame (CSP frame-src). Each must equal that MFE's ClientBaseUrls entry in src/IDP/appsettings.json and the address in the Shell menu (EwpBssShellDb).
//NotificationsApiBaseUrl: The Notifications API (https); the Shell forwards the person's token there.
